about_the_game:
Looming ivory towers. Stained glass windows. Elegant stonework that’s equal parts dramatic and timeless.

Whether you’re building a grand castle, a quiet countryside chapel, or a cozy cottage with a flair for the old world, the Gothic Build Style lets you shape your island with bold, architectural beauty.

Includes:

  • Towering arches, pointed roofs, and stained glass windows

  • Detailed stonework full of classic charm

  • Everything you need to build castles, cabins, chapels, manors, and more

From serene to spooky, minimal to majestic, this set is all about adding depth and drama to your builds - however you envision them.
